about: Xbox platform functions each title imports or links (system calls, XDK D3D runtime, D3DX/XGraphics, CRT, XAPI, audio, Xbox Live, libpng/zlib, import thunks), not the game's own code nor its middleware. ported = native in Any360 and bound in the title; ready = native in Any360, not bound in that title yet; covered = native in Any360 inside a parent the title binds natively (run only when that parent declines), counted apart; pacing = native, held back while the owner of frame pacing (owner) works on it; not_worth = native, checked, measured without a gain (why: the measure and its archive), bound in no title. Crackdown recounted 2026-11-27 (D3D range from 0x826AC6C8). Counts from the 2026-11-26 refresh of each title on Any360 main (81b3a4b / 226b68b / 65dcfdb); estimated = library ranges found by landmarks matched against other titles (no modules.json yet), +-10-20%.
